selectionPolicy: The user will review later. No browser draft, accepted kit or playable roster is changed by this shortlist.

heroes.headline: Keep the user's assembled draft as the review baseline.
heroes.reason: HP-based shields, cleansing and conditional recovery give a clear defensive identity. Shield conversion is the signature exception in this group.
heroes.tradeoff: Her two support Actives add no Break. Conversion spends her own protection and needs source-layer shields that the current runtime does not support.
heroes.mixNote: Do not replace the saved D/E/D/D/E draft with a pure option. Review the assembled Ultimate's ceiling after the base shield rules are implemented.
heroes.qualitativeComparison: Defense plus prepared burst; no defensible numeric rank before a stat line, layered shields and encounter tests exist.

heroes.mixNote: C Active1 is a clean emergency ally-heal swap, but it replaces the Provoke attack. Keep the D Passive for the counter identity.

numericalNotes.example: A Passive multiplies her proposed 18% recipient-HP heal to 19.8%. Her A2 gives 8.8% immediately plus two 4.4% Regeneration ticks, totaling 17.6% if both ticks occur.

Her Ultimate's extra 35% Max-HP damage per enemy needs 70% of her Max HP in shields actually consumed on Roselle. Five party shields are not pooled across five recipients. The 8% post-cast self-shield cannot fund the same cast.
B Ultimate grants each of five allies 15% of Isavelle's Max HP in separate recipient shields: 75% distributed coverage, not one 75% shield or an automatic Roselle cap.

rankingNote: No exact strength ranking is assigned: final stats, Speed, source-layer shield rules and implemented draft skills do not yet exist.

encounterNotes.scope: Eight adult female boss encounter proposals and four varied ordinary/elite silhouettes.
encounterNotes.artAcceptancePolicy: Encounter design work does not accept the sprite or add it to native content.
encounterNotes.powerPolicy: resolvedCombatPower means the final CombatSkillDefinition.Power before damage mitigation, area scale or other runtime modifiers; it is not a direct EnemySkillDefinition.Power assignment. Existing EnemyCombatSkills adds 70 for bosses or 52 for other enemies. Dedicated typed definitions must avoid applying this bonus twice.
encounterNotes.telegraphPolicy: Heavy actions must be visible before commitment and allow at least one living hero action before resolving. No new bonus turns, custom meters or hidden phase stats are proposed.

firstPassGoals: Keep familiar kits useful; two signature engines among eleven recommendations.
Measure single-target damage, wave damage, prevention and recovery separately instead of assigning one unexplained score.
Exercise at least one straightforward team and one mechanic-focused team against each integrated encounter.

comparisonSetup.positions: fixed saved 3x3 cells; preserve existing Front/Back rules
comparisonSetup.duration: six scheduled turns per hero, or encounter completion
comparisonSetup.note: This equal-investment setup is for future reproducible comparison, not a claim that a player's account has these stats.

existingRuntimeBenchmarks.measure: Damage per scheduled hero turn, useful damage without overkill, enemy actions before victory.
Direct and DoT damage separately; Burn versus Shadowfire remains separate.
Useful HP restored, overheal, removable debuffs cleared, ally deaths before the healer's turn.
Shield absorbed, actual damage prevented, interception and Frostplate uses as separate metrics.
Hostile application attempts/successes, control-immune failures, boss value when action denial is unavailable.

encounterGates: No first-pass generic boss action may remove a full-HP same-investment support in one noncritical neutral hit; if it does, reduce ATK or power before testing combinations.
A telegraphed heavy strike must allow one hero opportunity; do not use Speed or AI sequencing to skip the advertised answer.
Track effective HP, including actual healing and shielding. If recovery exceeds 20% of starting boss HP per three boss turns in the baseline test, lower the heal/guard budget before judging team DPS.
